name: hud_ui_options_panel_object_detail_init_from_options
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_ObjectDetail::InitFromOptions reads the current hardware-mode object LOD option and applies it to the cycle selector through SetIndexClamped.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40cab0 calls zOpt::GetObjectLODForCurrentHwMode, passes the result to HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::SetIndexClamped, and returns.

Native smoke zhud_options_panel_object_detail_init_from_options_smoke installs software and hardware ObjectLOD option pointers, exercises both hardware-mode selectors, and verifies the selected cycle index follows SetIndexClamped including low and visible-range clamping.
